name: 看图 Kantu (Tencent)
engine: macOS image frameworks (videos open in another player)
summary: Tencent's free Mac picture browser and organiser: browses folders such as Downloads without import, imports from phones and cameras, groups by faces, places and dates, finds duplicates and makes curated albums. It hasn't been updated since 2019.
where_it_wins: Face recognition, places map, duplicates finder, curated albums
Imports straight from phones, cameras and PTP devices
Ratings and filters for big files
where_schnellbild_wins: Maintained and native on Apple silicon (Kantu's last build is from 2019)
Plays videos itself, including MKV, AVI, WebM
Keyboard first with cheat sheet, dual pane, regex search
No login or cloud upload, never goes online
search_terms: 腾讯看图 停止更新
